_START_HERE: You are starting or continuing a ponytail session. ALWAYS start a new session by running a SYNC CHECK (see _meta.instructions.sync_rules) before doing anything else. Step 1: read _meta.instructions for full rules. Step 2: run the sync check. Step 3: check 'files' in review_order order.

_meta.purpose: Source-of-truth sitemap and change ledger for Safe Bloom (Flutter). Primary point of contact for project state.

workflow: 1. Read track.json FIRST — use it as context instead of re-reading every source file.
2. Go through files in review_order, one at a time.
3. After each review/edit, apply changes to the source file.
4. Update the file's entry in track.json: status → DONE, lines → actual count, changes_made → version entry.
5. Never edit a source file without logging what changed in changes_made.
review_rules: ponytail mode is always active: laziest solution that actually works.
Only cut over-engineering and complexity — correctness bugs are out of scope.
Tags: delete, stdlib, native, yagni, shrink.
Never flag smoke-tests or assert-based self-checks for deletion.
After applying changes, always get exact line count and update track.json.
Update changes_made with correct version key after every apply.
update_rules: Always update status to 'DONE — ponytail YYYY-MM-DD' after applying.
Always update lines to real post-edit count.
Always fill changes_made with version key and summary of work.

scope_options.all: Reset every file in 'files' back to PENDING review.
scope_options.single: Reset only the named file back to PENDING review.
scope_options.from <file>: Reset all files from the named file onward back to PENDING review.

steps: 1. Confirm scope with user before making changes.
2. For each file in scope: set status back to 'PENDING review'.
5. Confirm to user which files were reset.

sync_rules.when: Run at START of every new session, or when user says 'sync' or 'check files'.
sync_rules.fast_path: If sync diff is zero (0 new, 0 deleted, 0 renamed, 0 flagged) — skip report entirely and proceed directly.
steps: 1. List source files under project root.
2. Diff found paths against keys in 'files'.
3. NEW files: add entry with 'PENDING review'.
5. RENAMED/MOVED files: update key and review_order.

digits.X — first (major): Architectural changes, deleted functions/classes, public interface changes, new/removed modules.
digits.Y — middle (mid): Moderate refactors, method body simplifications, extracting helpers, branch collapsing.
digits.Z — last (minor): Small cosmetic changes, import cleanup, variable inlining, reformatting.

rules: Increment digit matching heaviest change in pass.
Digits do NOT reset on increment.
